description: This file implements the SetCaps class for configuring audio stream capabilities in a WebAudio context, including building GStreamer caps based on audio format configurations and updating the GStreamer pipeline accordingly.

classes.name: WebAudioCapsBuilder
classes.description: Abstract base class for building GStreamer caps for WebAudio streams.

classes.name: WebAudioPcmCapsBuilder
classes.description: Concrete implementation of WebAudioCapsBuilder for PCM audio format, constructing caps with specific format details.

classes.name: SetCaps
classes.description: Main class responsible for setting GStreamer caps based on WebAudio configuration and updating the pipeline.

methods.name: SetCaps
methods.description: Constructor initializing the SetCaps object with context, wrappers, mime type, and configuration.

methods.name: ~SetCaps
methods.description: Destructor logging the completion of SetCaps operations.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Performs the process of creating and setting GStreamer caps on the app source, and updates bytes per sample.

methods.name: createCapsFromMimeType
methods.description: Creates GstCaps object based on the mime type and configuration.

methods.name: setBytesPerSample
methods.description: Calculates and sets the bytes per sample in the context based on the PCM configuration.
